name: mcp-datasource-generator
description: Visual canvas-based application for creating MCP servers from MySQL databases

scripts.dev:instance1: dotenv -e .env -e .env.instance1 -- concurrently --names "backend-1,frontend-1" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:instance2: dotenv -e .env -e .env.instance2 -- concurrently --names "backend-2,frontend-2" --prefix-colors "blue,yellow" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:instance3: dotenv -e .env -e .env.instance3 -- concurrently --names "backend-3,frontend-3" --prefix-colors "green,red" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:instance1" "npm run dev:instance2" "npm run dev:instance3"
